# Packet review components `PRV`

[As built](../README.md) › Packet review components

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Preact components for the Gate 2 review experience: tabs for calls, work map, evidence, dependencies, findings, and repair rounds, plus shared state for navigating and deciding on a feature's packet. Gives human reviewers the detailed, criterion-by-criterion view needed to rule on a build before it merges.

19 files, 6,034 lines.
